name: Mahlah
bio: Mahlah was the eldest daughter of Zelophehad, of the tribe of Manasseh. Her father died in the wilderness leaving no sons, only her and her four sisters — Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah. Together they stood before Moses, the priest Eleazar, and the whole congregation, saying, "Our father died in the wilderness... and he had no sons. Why should our father's name disappear from his clan because he had no son? Give us property among our father's relatives" (Numbers 27:1-4). The LORD granted their request and decreed that when a man died without a son, his inheritance would pass to his daughters — an important precedent in Israel's inheritance law (Numbers 27:5-11). Afterward, Mahlah and her sisters married within their own clan as God commanded, so that the inheritance remained within the tribe of Manasseh (Numbers 36:10-12).
